Notes for Claude Code

Source: CLAUDE.md

The R package tflspec: Excel / YAML specifications of tables, listings and figures, turned into R programs that use rtfreporter. Exports start with tfl_.

The three packages

  • Dependency direction: rtfreporter <- tflspec <- tflplanner. The SPEC mirrors rtfreporter’s API: no shapes of its own; a change of shape starts in rtfreporter. tflspec can write every rtfreporter feature.

Pull requests

  • Do not change Version, NEWS.md or the AI manuals’ version line in a PR. Put the NEWS point in the PR description; the version is bumped only for a tagged snapshot or a CRAN submission.
  • Branch from main; do not stack PRs. One open PR at a time per group of files.
  • When a PR is ready, add the automerge label. If it must wait for another PR (a new sheet column needs tflplanner’s translation first), write one line in its description: merge-after: tflplanner#123.
  • Before a PR: the tests of what changed and lint. When sheet columns or the generated code change, also tflplanner’s related tests (test-app-robust, test-spec-yaml …) with this branch in a separate library. CI runs the rest.

Tests and code

  • Never copy tests into $TEMP; run them where they are.
  • Point R_USER_CONFIG_DIR, R_USER_DATA_DIR and R_USER_CACHE_DIR (and options(tflplanner.home)) at a work folder, never at the user’s own.
  • Run the tests in one R session too (testthat::test_dir() on the installed package), not only one file at a time.
  • R 4.6.1 (C:/Program Files/R/R-4.6.1/bin/Rscript.exe on Windows). ASCII-only R code (\uXXXX escapes). Split a file before it passes 2,000 lines.
